identity_check: Confirmed as Procol (procol.ai; procol.io and procol.in redirect there), the Gurugram procurement-software company run by Procol Tech Pvt. Ltd and founded in 2018 by Gaurav Baheti and Sumit Mendiratta. The company's about page (2018 founding in Gurugram, Blume, Sequoia Surge, Y Combinator and Beenext as early backers, the 2022 ₹51 crore round), Blume Ventures' October 2026 portfolio essay, Inc42 and Mint (September 2022 Series A) and Inc42's company profile all describe the same company and founders. Category set to 'direct' (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate found through Blume Ventures' portfolio): Procol sells autonomous procurement agents (intake, sourcing with negotiation and supplier discovery, auto-award, should-cost, supplier onboarding and risk, PO and AP) to Indian enterprises with manufacturing as its first listed industry (Tata Group, AM/NS India, Apollo Tyres, Havells, Dixon), and it offers RFQ and BOM generator tools. That is Utopian Autonomy's procurement / RFQ wedge in the same home market, and Blume's essay says the business began by moving buyers' WhatsApp-based awarding onto software. This follows the precedent for Didero and Galvant. Differences: Procol is a horizontal source-to-pay and accounts-payable suite sold to procurement and finance leaders across all industries (retail, real estate, pharma, IT), used through a web app and ERP integrations; it does not touch maintenance, process stability or engineering drawings, and no WhatsApp channel for plant staff was seen on its site.

company.name: Procol
company.description: Gurugram-founded procurement platform whose AI agents run sourcing, negotiation, supplier management, purchase orders and accounts payable for enterprises, many of them Indian manufacturers.

layer_detail: Procurement / source-to-pay back office rather than the plant floor (no supply-chain layer in the taxonomy; plant_ops is the nearest fit, as for Didero and Galvant). Agent suites: Guided Intake, Autonomous Sourcing (demand aggregation, negotiation, supplier discovery, auto-award, bid analysis, should-cost), Supplier Risk & Monitoring (onboarding, due diligence, scorecards), Accounts Payable Concierge (invoice capture and matching, payments), AI Spend Control Tower and an orchestration engine, branded 'Clara'. Also eAuction, vendor portal and free RFQ, RFP, BOM and PO generators. Started as a commodity auction platform for food companies before rebuilding as enterprise software.
product_summary: Agentic source-to-pay platform: AI agents (branded Clara) handle purchase intake, sourcing events and e-auctions, supplier negotiation and discovery, award decisions, supplier onboarding and risk checks, purchase orders, invoice matching and payments, with spend analytics, under customer-set policies and integrated with ERPs such as SAP, Oracle and Tally.
